Ticket Id: 25709

Dr. Ben Hinds

Psychiatry Registrar

Maroubra Hospital

Lakes Road

Maroubra

7/3/2011

Dear Dr. hinds,                                                                                            Comment [teacher1]: H

RE: Yuxiang Meng

Thank you for seeing Mr. Meng, a 21-year-old Chinese student chef whose features are suggestive of acute
manic disorder. He lives with his uncle at the same home and he knows the basic English.                   Comment [teacher2]: only

On 2/3/2011, Mr. Meng presented with upper respiratory tract infection. However, he was observed to
have elevated mood. He had delusions and was talking about fixing the world's nuclear waste problem. On
examination, manic episode was suspected. Accordingly, he was referred to the local community mental       Comment [teacher3]: a
health team. Diazepam 10 mg was also prescribed.

On the next day, the mental health team provisionally diagnosed that it was non dangerous mania.           Comment [teacher4]: a non-
However, they were keen to avoid hospitalization because the patient was afraid of psychiatry ward.        Comment [teacher5]: the
Therefore, the patient was commenced on quetiapine. They recommended also decreasing the frequency
of Diazepam to be twice per day.                                                                           Comment [teacher6]: d

On today review, the patient's uncle reported that Mr. Meng had discarded his medications. He also         Comment [teacher7]: today’s
reported that last night he was running naked down the street. On examination, he was very elevated in     Comment [teacher8]: , Mr Meng
mood with exaggerated previous delusions. He stripped nude and tried to hug me. Diazepam 20 mg and         Comment [teacher9]: naked
quetiapine were prescribed but he refused to take any medications.

In view of the above, I am referring this patient for your further assessment and management. For any
queries, please contact me.

Yours sincerely

Doctor

                              choice. However, flow of information is logical

 Advice                       1. Revise grammar.
                              2. Be careful with capitalisation.
                              3. Improve choice of words.
                              4. Always proofread the letter after finishing it.
